CAREERS
Want to help change the world? Become a member of the exciting, dynamic, and
challenging world of renewable energy. SCADA Solutions specializes in restoring
infrastructure integrity through the integration of communications and SCADA systems.
Our products and services are as good as our winning teams, who design, engineer,
integrate, install, and service them. Please check back regularly or contact our
Human Resources Department for opportunities. Come and grow with us; together,
we can make a difference.

North American Jobs
SCADA Engineer
SCADA Solutions is currently looking for talented, highly motivated, and dependable
software engineers (junior and experienced) to join our team in the San Diego area.
This is your chance to work with some of the brightest SCADA engineers in the land.
Responsibilities
You will be directly involved in developing the next generation of our flagship
WindCapture™ product. Work will encompass all aspects of the software design and
development processes in an informal but over-achieving environment.
Primary Requirements
› Science or Technical Degree from accredited university, e.g. BS in Electrical Engineering (BSEE)
› 3+ years relevant experience
› Experience with Allen Bradley PLC and FactoryTalk/RSView
› Strong communications skills (written and verbal), including ability to write detailed technical reports
› SQL and MS Access database application experience
› Experience with electronic converters and drivers
Compensation / Benefits
SSI offers competitive compensation packages for the right candidates
and is an equal opportunity employer.
Email resume and cover letter to: info@scadasolutions.com (subject: SCADA Engineer)
SCADA Programmer
SCADA Solutions is currently looking for talented, highly motivated, and dependable
field technicians (junior and experienced) to join our team in the San Diego area.
This is your chance to work in one of the fastest-growing industries: renewable energy.
Responsibilities
You will be directly involved in our cutting-edge SCADA system architecture and
configuration. Work encompasses testing, simulating, installing, and servicing our
communications and SCADA software solution networks. You will be traveling to wind
farm projects around the country about 30% of the time. Your involvement will include
project management, server configuration, troubleshooting, and technical support.
Primary Requirements
› Science or Technical Degree from accredited university, e.g. BS in Electrical Engineering (BSEE)
› 3+ years relevant experience
› Experience with Allen Bradley PLC and FactoryTalk/RSView
› Strong communications skills (written and verbal), including ability to write detailed technical reports
› RF Communications experience
› Experience with electronic converters and drivers
› Experience with fiber optics and cable assemblies
› Experience deploying software systems
Compensation / Benefits
SSI offers competitive compensation packages for the right candidates
and is an equal opportunity employer.
Email resume and cover letter to: info@scadasolutions.com (subject: SCADA Programmer)

APPLICANT PRIVACY POLICY #PrivacyPolicy (ContentLeftSection: image left / text right)
privacy-policy.jpg
Applicant Privacy Policy
SCADA Solutions respects the privacy of any personal information we obtain in
connection with your application for employment. Your personal information will
be used to determine your suitability for a position within SSI and, if applicable,
your terms of employment or engagement. Your details may be held in paper or
electronic form for up to two years. SSI may disclose your details to verify or
obtain additional information about you from third parties, including education
claims, previous employment, and references.
We take every precaution to protect your privacy. If you have concerns, questions,
or comments about your privacy in your dealings with SCADA Solutions, please contact us.
